technique_name: Create an article on how computer vision is used in medical imaging.
description: Computer vision is being increasingly used in medical imaging in order to detect, diagnose and monitor disease more accurately and efficiently. Medical imaging plays an important role in the accuracy of diagnosis of a wide range of diseases, including neurological disorders, cardiovascular diseases, cancer, and orthopedic disorders.
